event_data: 288 documents /72 ordered meanings per development and evaluation split, nine categories, four input goal pairs. No ordered-meaning overlap. Evaluator-only old synthetic grammar generates/scorers. New paired documents, not a new natural-language grammar or independent human corpus.
learning_boundary: Component learner fits only 432 single-event text/meaning pairs and explicit lexical priors, same seed/dimension/memory mode as v0.6 primary. Two-event segmentation and bindings are designed, not learned. No two-event examples enter fitting. Four evaluation seeds vary only new event codes, not the component model.
signal: One D-dimensional complex128 vector with two bound frames including per-event presence signals; bound amplitude1/sqrt(2). No event meaning/text/subpacket list in transport. Event positions mean mention order, not time or causation. Decoder has global public slot candidates, not per-document hints. Reader compares decoded signal to its own two candidates before acceptance; generator recovers signal independently and outputs atomically.
controls: partitioned uses two ordered D/2 halves, same total numeric payload D but no overlapping event frames. unbound superposes without event labels; swapped distinct events produce exactly equal vectors. Compare only payload coefficient count, not whole-runtime RAM or speed equality. Both controls also use phase role/value codes; this is not a test of SS superiority over symbolic lists.
gates: Every standard mode/seed/stage exact rate>=.98; each of nine categories complete exact success; no accepted wrong event/slot/order, invalid documents or malformed packets. Source read signals must recover. Original single-event regression passes. At every codec seed, swapped distinct events must have different bound/partitioned vectors and identical unbound vectors. At D8192 zero-noise bound recovery exact>=.98. No-learning cannot complete outputs. Low-dimensional/noise failures are measured, not gated away. Counters are recomputed from per-request records.
limits: Exactly two explicit terminated sentences, no pronoun resolution or omitted arguments
Mention order only; no temporal or causal inference
No learned event segmentation or binding discovery
No P1 observation-mask or S1 chips/synchronization integration
No all-SS learning or general document generation
R1 inference and Concept updates remain disabled
